problem_statement: Casual walkers struggle to maintain consistent daily walking habits due to a lack of personalized feedback and motivation.
objectives: Enable users to manually log daily step counts.
Provide personalized suggestions based on historical step data to encourage habit consistency.
Ensure a simple, accessible interface for casual users.

user_stories.story: As a casual walker, I want to manually log my daily step count, so that I can keep a record of my activity.
As a casual walker, I want to receive personalized suggestions based on my recent step history, so that I stay motivated to build my walking habit.

functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow the user to input a numerical value representing daily steps.
The system shall validate that the input step count is a non-negative integer.
The system shall generate a suggestion based on the average of the last 7 days of logged steps.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall sanitize all user inputs to prevent injection attacks, ensuring no malicious scripts are executed through the input fields.
The interface shall be optimized for mobile browsers to support casual walkers on the go.
The system shall handle invalid data types gracefully without crashing or exposing stack traces.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the user is on the log screen, When they enter a valid number and save, Then the system confirms the entry is stored.
Given the user enters a negative number or non-numeric text, When they attempt to save, Then the system displays an error message and prevents submission.
Given the user has 7 days of data, When they view the dashboard, Then the system displays a suggestion based on the calculated 7-day average.

constraints.description: The system must rely solely on manual user entry; no automated wearable integration is permitted for V1.

assumptions.description: Users will have access to a modern web browser to interact with the system.

in_scope: Basic suggestion engine based on averages

open_questions.question: What specific types of suggestions should be provided (e.g., 'walk 500 more steps' vs 'great job')?
Should the system support user accounts for data persistence, or is local browser storage sufficient for V1?
